# Engineer: TypeScript + Vite Testing

Role: Engineer
Purpose: Provide guidelines and examples for testing TypeScript code in a Vite-powered app (unit + integration).
Inputs: Test runner choice (Vitest/Jest), existing test utils, DOM setup for components.
Constraints: Keep tests fast; mock external network calls and heavy dependencies.
Outputs: Example test config, sample unit and component tests, and CI job snippets.
